question: languages_spoken
finest_level: commune (plus urban arrondissements; also province and region rows; separate urban/rural sheets)
categories: 5 local varieties: Darija, Tachelhit, Tamazight, Tarifit, Hassania (others written in but not tabulated); shares in % of population
older_census: 2014 and 2004 asked the same item (HCP note: since 2004); 1994 'primary language' (IPUMS LANGMA, 1994/2004/2014)
fallback: IPUMS-I microdata 2014 (gated) gives LANGMA = first-listed local language, a single-language proxy per person
notes: Item is 'Langues locales utilisées (non exclusives)' = local languages used daily, multi-response; national 2024 shares Darija 91.9, Tachelhit 14.2, Tamazight 7.4, Tarifit 3.2, Hassania 0.8 (sums to ~117%). Not mother tongue: HCP note says people able to speak Amazigh but not using it daily are not counted. Workbook 'Indicateurs démographiques et socioéconomiques ... RGPH 2024' (~2,020 rows, codes to commune/arrondissement) is percentages only, combine with commune population. Amazigh activists (AMREC) dispute the 2024 figures as undercounts. Also has literacy-language columns (Arabic, Amazigh Tifinagh, French, English). Includes the Moroccan-administered Western Sahara communes. Province monographs (hcp.ma/region-*/docs) repeat the table per province.
